title: Design: Bill To lock toasts carry a Close button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A that has been invoiced (Invoiced or Paid), so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-04-after-click.png, bt-p3-08-after-click.png, bt-p3-11-after-click.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the Bill To value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The red toast shows "Go To Invoice" and, after it, a white "Close" button.
  • For a user without Finance tab access the toast shows only "Close" and has no caption line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R2: “Clicking or tapping the Invoiced field shows M4 as an error toast with a "Go To Invoice" button.”
  • S5-N1: “Without 'Invoicing & payments → View' and 'See Financial Data', the M4 toast shows with no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Click" (This build), "Click" (This build), "Click" (This build).

  • “Error toast with the same words and "Go To Invoice" and "Close".”
